featured_reviews.name: Rajan kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1/5 – Extremely Disappointing Experience

Driving School: Tarana Motor Training School
Location: Shop No. 5, Lower Kharodi, Malad–Marve Road, Opp. Sagar Hotel, Malvani, Malad West, Mumbai – 400095
Course Taken: 20 classes
Amount Paid: ₹3,500
Duration: December 2025 (Started on 1st December)

I am writing this review after purchasing 20 driving classes for ₹3,500 in December 2025. I started my classes on 1st December and currently have around 4 classes remaining, which I have decided not to attend due to the highly unprofessional experience.

Unfortunately, my experience matched many of the negative reviews already posted by other learners. I had read them earlier but still decided to give the school a chance—regrettably, the issues were exactly the same.

Trainer Experience

My assigned trainer was Santosh (surname unknown). His conduct throughout the sessions was unprofessional and inappropriate.

Each class is supposed to be 30 minutes, but actual teaching lasted only 10–15 minutes

He frequently asked for tea and snacks during class time

Around the 12th and 16th sessions, he started demanding “guru dakshina”

After I did not respond positively, his behavior changed—he became aggressive and shouted over minor mistakes

Errors occurred mainly due to poor instruction and unnecessary distractions, which is unsafe for new learners

Vehicle & Teaching Quality

The training car was in very poor condition and stalled 3–4 times almost every session

Full control was never given; the instructor constantly kept his foot on the dual clutch and brake

At the same time, he shouted contradictory instructions, making learning confusing and stressful

Overall training lacked structure, patience, and basic civic sense

Unprofessional Upselling

The instructor also tried to offer personal tuition after class hours, which I strongly advise learners not to consider, given the quality of regular training.

Side Note (Important)

When I initially contacted the school, the manager/owner (an elderly gentleman) dismissed all negative Google reviews, claiming they were fake and stating that anyone can post reviews by asking team members. This itself raised serious concerns.

He claimed that driving can be learned in 10 classes, which may apply only to basic vehicle movement. However, when I asked about structured learning for:

Parking (parallel & reverse)

Driving in traffic

Proper clutch, brake, and accelerator control

Reverse and hill driving

he clearly stated that only basic driving is taught, and everything else must be learned independently. Even when I asked about paying extra for structured training, it was declined.

Final Verdict

This experience was a complete waste of time and money. If you genuinely want to learn driving properly and confidently, please consider other professional driving schools or learn from someone you trust.

I would not recommend Tarana Motor Training School to new learners.
